field.name: pa_tax_rate
field.comment: PA flat tax rate 3.07% (2025). Applies to all 8 income classes. Source: 72 P.S. § 7302

field.name: pa_taxable_compensation
field.comment: PA Class 1: Compensation (W-2 wages, salaries). Excludes military retirement. Source: 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(1)

field.name: pa_taxable_interest
field.comment: PA Class 2: Interest income (1099-INT). Source: 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(2)

field.name: pa_taxable_net_profits
field.comment: PA Class 4: Net profits from business, profession, or farm (Schedule C/F). Source: 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(4)

field.name: pa_taxable_gains
field.comment: PA Class 5: Net gains from disposition of property (Schedule D). Source: 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(5)

field.name: pa_taxable_rents_royalties
field.comment: PA Class 6: Rents, royalties, patents, copyrights (Schedule E). Source: 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(6)

field.name: pa_taxable_estate_trust
field.comment: PA Class 7: Estate or trust income (Schedule K-1). Source: 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(7)

field.name: pa_taxable_gambling
field.comment: PA Class 8: Gambling and lottery winnings (W-2G). Source: 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(8)

field.name: pa_total_income
field.comment: Total PA taxable income (sum of 8 classes). Source: PA-40 Line 7

field.name: pa_tax
field.comment: PA income tax (pa_total_income × 3.07%). Source: PA-40 Line 13

field.name: pa_excludes_all_retirement
field.comment: PA excludes ALL retirement income: pensions, Social Security, IRA distributions, military retirement. 72 P.S. § 7303(a)(6)

field.name: pa_military_retirement_exclusion
field.comment: PA military retirement exclusion (computed). 100% excluded from PA compensation.

field.name: pa_social_security_exclusion
field.comment: PA Social Security exclusion (computed). 100% excluded from PA income.

field.name: pa_pension_exclusion
field.comment: PA pension exclusion (computed). 100% excluded from PA income.

field.name: pa_ira_exclusion
field.comment: PA IRA distribution exclusion (computed). 100% excluded from PA income.
